name: Sforzando Ryuuzou
source:
A member of the Aeroseven BKT.

[spoiler]As well as the culprit behind the Visage Lock Zero Case, a member of the religious cult Weeping Angels, nihilist cult Black Lotus Society, and metal band Black Rabbit Psycholocalypse. She would go on to betray the BKT and the Weeping Angels in favor of the Black Lotus Society.[/spoiler]
